sourceChanges.reason: Original command writes were gated on busy/AUX status, so idle startup never sent D4/EA/F4 and read an ACK that was never requested. Wait for clear IBF at each write, real OBF before ACK, bounded retries on NACK and bounded errors. Actual owning protocol RED before writes, GREEN idle/busy/resend/error/stuck cases. Mouse position originally clamped before deltas and to the whole800x600screen, allowing the20x31cursor to disappear; clamp after complete packets to780x569. Actual owning corner/selection RED/GREEN and all four real rendered corner photos.

Existing draw/movement code used one-based occupied slots up to count on50/100element arrays, and discarded objects without reducing count. Actual sustained-fire browser UBSan RED proj.c449 index50 outside int[50], plus actual whole-game-loop bounds regression RED. Make one-based slots1..50/100 valid, initialize each spawned slot, reduce counts on collision/retirement, stop testing a removed projectile and retire offscreen shots. Remove automatic MENU arrays that shadowed persistent sprite tables. Initial hearts3 now match the three-entry table even before the first menu timer. Whole real loop GREEN with normal and early-input startup, sustained fire, score/menu/Exit notifications; final instrumented browser GREEN. Preload the gameplay and HUD XPMs once before the main loop and reuse them, and drop the per-enemy debug prints; removes the per-frame/per-spawn allocations and console I/O without changing what is drawn.

Position tables now have the valid one-based slots used by original rendering and initialize1..50/100. Up/down previously overshot the top guard and clipped the102pxdog below the600pxscreen. Clamp resulting motion to10..498 for the original120x102sprites. Actual owning repeated-motion renderer RED/GREEN keeps the complete original artwork visible.
